items.title: What Does Eaton (ETN) Winning An Air Force Quantum Grid Contract Mean?
items.summary: Eaton (NYSE:ETN) received a U.S. Air Force Research Laboratory contract to apply quantum computing and machine learning for power grid resilience. The project focuses on advanced security solutions for critical infrastructure, extending beyond Eaton's existing electrification and data center work.
